claim_boundary: These are paired arbitrary-window FX2/WRT receipts. They are not official prefix scores, counted submission integrations, full-corpus results, or a 10.95% proof.

native_backend.build_contract: Research worktree snapshot with experimental features at default-off values and the PPMD MAP_FIXED remap correction; SEED=923, UPDATE_LIMIT=3000, GCC 13.3.0, O3/Os, march=native, fast-math, no-strict-aliasing.
native_backend.paired_comparison_note: Both control and candidate use the identical binary and WRT dictionary. This is not a claim of byte-identical public fx2 reproduction.

wrt_diagnostic.interpretation: The representation is shorter after WRT at both scopes, but the final FX2 archives are larger. The inline markers damage predictor context more than their length reduction pays.

upstream_build_failure.reason: The unmodified base commit lost the PPMD mmap heap address at periodic remap and received SIGSEGV. It produced no candidate archive comparison.

retirement_reason: The frozen candidate is negative on both matched native FX2/WRT scopes before any integration source bytes are charged. No marker, alias, selectivity, or weight sweep on this pre-WRT shape is justified.

next_mechanism.name: wrt_title_token_automaton_v1
next_mechanism.state_contract: Capture current-page title WRT token IDs and literal expansions only after they decode; build a bounded page-local prefix/failure automaton; expose exact title-prefix match length and predicted next token/byte to an online fixed-point endpoint; update regret only after decoded truth.
next_mechanism.control: Run the mechanically identical previous-page-title automaton as a matched control.
next_mechanism.promotion_gate: On disjoint 500K and 1M exact FX2 traces, require more than 700 gross B/1M at every scope before code, positive gain after measured code/state cost, bounded regressions, causal replay identity, and no confirmation tuning.
next_mechanism.reason: It preserves the original WRT stream and asks whether title state improves probability, avoiding the destructive inline-marker representation that failed here.
